method_notes: Scope = every citations.json key in FAR parts 22-53 (29 keys), DFARS/PGI/AFARS (9 keys) and U.S.C./CFR (24 keys). FAR: fetched each RFO part page (acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/far-part-deviation-guide/far-overhaul-part-NN) on 13 Sep 2026 and read the section lists and text; 'verified' = the new section number and heading were seen on the page, 'probable' = the mapping is inferred from structure without line-by-line text comparison. DFARS/PGI: acquisition.gov/dfars still serves the codified (pre-RFO) text, so mappings come from the DFARS Revolutionary FAR Overhaul class deviations at acq.osd.mil (memo PDFs and TAB A1 .docx attachments; text extracted locally with PyMuPDF and zipfile). The truncated keys DFARS 20/21/22/25, PGI 20/21/22, AFARS 51 and AFARS PGI 51 were resolved by reading the raw question/answer text in src/data/questions.json for the listed QIDs. AFARS: acquisition.gov shows 'No AFARS Text' during the RFO; used the public AFARS combined PDF (30 Jun 2026) hosted on army.mil (Army Connect). Statutes: uscode.house.gov refused connections, so each section was confirmed on law.cornell.edu (current status, heading, prior classification). Statutes and CFR are unaffected by the RFO; renumbered or repealed statutes appear as entries, all others in 'unchanged'. FAR parts 1-21 were out of scope for this file except where a new-number target (e.g., 2.101) is the crosswalk result.
